name: frontend-skills
description: React/TypeScript frontend enforcement harness. 82 wired hooks (85 scripts) enforce patterns on every edit. 41 skills from TDD through CI-green PR. 21 LLM failure modes (7 Karpathy single-agent + 14 MAST multi-agent, Cemri et al. NeurIPS 2025), OWASP + STRIDE, Core Web Vitals gate, worktree isolation + branch safety, agent-browser integration (~91% token reduction). 9 agents (3 plan-review hats + karpathy reference), 5 routines. Single-source manifest codegen. Opus 4.7 tuned. POSIX-friendly.

interface.shortDescription: React/TypeScript enforcement harness — 68 hooks, 41 skills, 5 agents, 5 routines
interface.longDescription: 68 hooks enforce patterns on every edit (accessibility, Tailwind, React Compiler, Zustand, TanStack Router, connect-query, form validation, error handling, and more). 41 skills guide the full development lifecycle from TDD through CI-green PR. 5 agents (code-reviewer, adversarial-reviewer, self-reviewer, verifier, findings-schema) run automated review rounds. 5 routines automate recurring team workflows (PR review, issue triage, docs drift, weekly health). TypeScript-scoped. Caveman-compressed for 74% token savings.

x-changelog.4.4.0: 2026-04-21 -- MCP ban hook now wired. mcp-ban.sh existed (denies Jira/Gmail/browser/Blacksmith/Calendar/Drive/Buildkite/Box/M365 MCP calls with CLI redirect, saves ~20x tokens) but was never registered in PreToolUse — silent no-op. Added matcher `mcp__.*` to .claude/settings.json, .codex/hooks.json, and skill-manifest.json (source of truth). evals/test-mcp-ban.sh updated to check both configs (was pointing at nonexistent hooks/hooks.json stub). 17/17 eval pass.
x-changelog.4.3.2: 2026-04-20 -- P0 plugin-install resilience. source-hook-lib.sh adds relative-path fallback (`$shim/../../shared/hook-lib.sh`) before git rev-parse last resort. Handles the dangling-symlink install failure where the Claude plugin packager absolute-ified the `_hook-lib.sh -> ../../shared/hook-lib.sh` relative link to a broken path, making every PostToolUse hook fail with `hook_parse_edit_write: command not found`. Codex plugin ships root so not directly affected, but shim is shared.

CI-pending / coverage-unavailable / no-vitest paths downgraded from block to warn -- the coverage-unavailable block was causing an infinite /tdd loop. Hard blocks reserved for evidence-based conditions. react-doctor-stop: warn-only branch for known incomplete dead-code failure. 8 evals green (2 new).
